diagnosis: The Livewire attachment manager component deletes helpdesk files using the public $attachmentId property without ensuring that the caller is the author of the ticket or an active support technician. An authenticated client can delete logs and diagnostic attachments belonging to other users' support cases.

POST /livewire/update HTTP/1.1
Host: support.cloudhelpdesk.io
Authorization: Bearer 14|custhelpdesk99
Content-Type: application/json
